## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 104 captures during May 2026. This represents the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading information reported below. The activity count is presented as captures rather than as a separate measure of attendance or appointments.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.9. This indicates that the images associated with those captures could not be used for grading. The result is reported alongside the number of ungradable captures to provide both the rate and the corresponding count for the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 19 referable captures. The median lag was 2. This records the midpoint of the time between capture and completion of grading. The grading result is reported separately from image quality, so that referable findings and ungradable images are not combined.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during May 2026. The report therefore records the month’s activity, image-quality outcome and grading results without any additional equipment issue noted.
